judgments.reason: The passage states that depth and semantic segmentation are pseudo-sensors that support experiments that control for the role of perception.
The passage explicitly says that additional sensor models can be plugged in via the API.
The passage lists the 12 semantic classes provided by the pseudo-sensor, matching the claim exactly.
The passage states that CARLA provides a range of measurements associated with the state of the agent and compliance with traffic rules.

The passage lists these exact measurements as examples of the agent's state: vehicle location and orientation with respect to the world coordinate system, speed, acceleration vector, and accumulated impact from collisions.

The passage states that measurements concerning traffic rules include the percentage of the vehicle’s footprint that impinges on wrong-way lanes or sidewalks, as well as states of the traffic lights and the speed limit at the current location of the vehicle.
The passage says that CARLA provides access to exact locations and bounding boxes of all dynamic objects in the environment.
The passage states that these signals play an important role in training and evaluating driving policies.
The passage says that CARLA supports development, training, and detailed performance analysis of autonomous driving systems.
